Correct. Noissa matches taloissa in inessive case and plural number.
“nuo” is a plural nominative form for farther, jointly visible referents; use “noissa”, the plural inessive form linked to nuo.
“niissä” is the plural inessive form linked to ne; use “noissa”, the plural inessive form linked to nuo.
“Avaimet ovat noissa talossa.” changes the supplied form or word order. The required sentence is “Avaimet ovat noissa taloissa.”: Noissa matches taloissa in inessive case and plural number.
